stories.title: Los alumnos responden a lo que se dice de ellos por PISA: “Se nos reduce a una nota y perdemos motivación”

en.title: Students respond to what is said about them by PISA: "We are reduced to a grade and lose motivation"
en.summary: About ten students aged 15 to 17 discuss results from an educational report showing Spain's poor performance. While acknowledging screen time impacts learning, they call for systemic changes and want their voices heard.

stories.title: Las cartas de una familia que cuentan la Guerra Civil desde ambos lados: “Que Dios nos ayude”

en.title: Letters from a family that tell the Spanish Civil War from both sides: "May God help us"
en.summary: A collection of old letters preserved in cloth containing an image of the Virgin Mary documents the brutal ruptures, fear, family bonds, and survival struggles experienced during wartime from different perspectives.

stories.title: Von der Leyen anuncia un plan de seguridad para Europa sin Estados Unidos

en.title: Von der Leyen announces a security plan for Europe without the United States
en.summary: The European Commission president proposes creating a security mechanism for EU countries and partner nations including Canada and the United Kingdom, excluding the United States.

stories.title: Feijóo se enroca con Vox y cierra la puerta a que ningún menor de Ceuta vaya a la Península

en.title: Feijóo digs in with Vox and closes the door to any minors from Ceuta going to the Peninsula
en.summary: The Government claims the PP blocks solutions for the Ceuta minor crisis despite the negative impact on the city.

stories.title: La jueza busca quién coordinó, financió y decidió el operativo de la entrada masiva a Ceuta en Marruecos

en.title: Judge seeks to identify who coordinated, financed and decided the mass entry operation into Ceuta from Morocco
en.summary: A judge is requesting intelligence agency assistance to identify individuals who may have organized and guided migrants during a mass crossing into Ceuta, and has ordered police to check international databases.

stories.title: Las claves de la reforma de las leyes de dependencia y discapacidad

en.title: Key aspects of the reform of dependency and disability laws
en.summary: Spain's parliament approved reforms to dependency and disability laws that will take effect upon publication, with some measures beginning immediately while others require regulatory development.

stories.title: El veto de los socialistas para blindar a Marruecos boicotea una resolución de apoyo a Ceuta en Europa

en.title: Socialist veto to shield Morocco undermines European Parliament resolution supporting Ceuta
en.summary: A socialist veto is making it increasingly difficult for the European Parliament to approve a resolution of support for Ceuta, despite European Commission statements affirming Ceuta's Spanish and European status.

stories.title: Mbappé explica por qué no se enfundó la camiseta en apoyo a Ceuta: “Quería tener también un gesto con los inmigrantes”

en.title: Mbappé explains why he did not wear the shirt in support of Ceuta: "I wanted to also make a gesture with immigrants"
en.summary: Mbappé clarified his decision not to wear a solidarity shirt for Ceuta that some clubs adopted following a campaign by Valencian businessmen, stating he wanted to acknowledge immigrants who have lost their lives.

stories.title: Mbappé rompe su silencio tras la polémica por Ceuta: "Quería tener un pensamiento con todos los inmigrantes que han perdido la vida"

en.title: Mbappé breaks his silence after the Ceuta controversy: "I wanted to have a thought for all the immigrants who have lost their lives"
en.summary: Mbappé stated he has solidarity with Ceuta while explaining that the decision to wear the shirt was made by clubs, not players.

stories.title: Mbappé: “Me solidarizo con Ceuta, pero también quería tener un gesto con los inmigrantes”

en.title: Mbappé: "I show solidarity with Ceuta, but I also wanted to make a gesture with immigrants"
en.summary: Mbappé explains his decision to conceal his shirt during a match, stating he supports Ceuta while also seeking to send a message of positivity and peace regarding immigrants.

stories.title: Claves | Ayuda a domicilio, accesibilidad y menos burocracia: los 10 puntos esenciales de la reforma de dependencia y discapacidad

en.title: Key points | Home care, accessibility and less bureaucracy: the 10 essential points of the dependency and disability reform
en.summary: Parliament definitively approved the most significant reform in 20 years of dependency law, addressing home assistance, accessibility improvements, and reduced administrative requirements.

stories.title: Von der Leyen se dirige a los ceutíes: “La frontera de Ceuta es la frontera de Europa y Europa estará ahí para vosotros”

en.title: Von der Leyen addresses Ceuta residents: "Ceuta's border is Europe's border and Europe will be there for you"
en.summary: The European Commission president proposes creating a European response mechanism to address large-scale irregular migrant entries at the Ceuta border.

stories.title: ¿Quién es quién en la revolución de la IA?

en.title: Who's who in the AI revolution?
en.summary: Artificial intelligence founders have transformed a science fiction concept into a daily tool within four years, with key figures including computer scientists, tech magnates, and a Nobel Prize winner now shaping the progress versus security debate.

stories.title: La Bolsa se adentra en la "zona de peligro"

en.title: The stock market enters the "danger zone"
en.summary: Interest rates, debt, oil prices, and AI developments create a fragile market environment, with quantitative analysis and sentiment indicators showing uncertainty levels that suggest negative stock market performance ahead.

stories.title: Los valores rezagados del Ibex con más gancho para invertir

en.title: Lagging Ibex stocks offer more appeal for investors
en.summary: Companies trailing the Ibex's 2026 gains have declined between 6% and 23% this year but hold over 78% buy recommendations and trade at discounts of 24% to 48%.

stories.title: Santander será el proveedor exclusivo de servicios financieros de la CNMV

en.title: Santander will be the exclusive provider of financial services for the CNMV
en.summary: Santander has been selected as the exclusive financial services provider to Spain's market regulator, with the first-year contract valued at 475,530 euros. The role was previously held by BBVA for three decades.

stories.title: Sabadell y Bankinter, los más generosos con sus directivos

en.title: Sabadell and Bankinter, the most generous with their executives
en.summary: Spanish listed banks have increased compensation for top executives to 54 million euros combined. Santander shows the largest gap between its chief executive's salary and the average employee compensation.
